market_selection: Exactly the two listed markets are included before stage-e performance. Do not replace or omit a market based on a subsequent score.

markets.reason: Directly tests the specific prior failure: phase-d structure rolled back to initialization and underperformed price Ridge on this period.

First eligible source under the independently recorded availability/quality priority; previous project records contain source/QC and a data appendix but no discovered CEA forecast performance evaluation.
markets.exposure_qualification: Raw source values have been read and QC'd; new scoring does not mean previously unseen raw data. Absence of earlier model scoring is based on repository evidence, not a claim about all possible off-repository activity.

shared_target: Published rounded daily total transaction mean, CNY per tonne; not listed-trade closing price, and not recomputed turnover divided by volume.
prediction_origin: After the current daily price/volume report is available.
horizon_unit: Subsequent observed transaction records, not an asserted fixed calendar-day interval.
volume_context: Current log1p total volume relative to strictly prior 60 observed records, valid after at least 10 past observations; same transformation as the recorded phase-d official series.
information: Price and volume only in the new learned models; no future covariate path is supplied. Targets may supervise fitting only after all h20 labels in that fitting subset have matured.
split: Fixed chronological 60/20/20 raw-row split, floor 0.6N and then floor 0.2N; every joint-label fitting origin must have h20 target before the next subset boundary. The evaluation weights remain fixed while observed input history advances.
reporting: Development and confirmation reported separately. A combined two-market mean, if shown, is descriptive and cannot be presented as two independent new confirmations.
data_license: No source redistribution license established; raw documents and canonical row-level tables remain private. Public files contain reproducible retrieval instructions, identifiers, hashes and aggregate QC.
